hadith.english: Aisha: on Eid two girls sang songs of Buath at her house; Abu Bakr objected but the Prophet said every people has a festival and this is ours.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha: when a wind or dark cloud came the Prophet was uneasy, fearing it might be punishment for his people, and he was relieved when it rained.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Umm Salamah: whoever is struck by a calamity and says "We belong to Allah and to Him we return; O Allah, reward me in my affliction and give me something better", Allah gives him something better.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Anas: patience is at the first blow; the Prophet told a woman weeping for her child to fear Allah and be patient.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: make haste with the funeral; if the dead person was righteous you are sending him to good, and if not you are putting an evil from your necks.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Buraydah: the Prophet said he had forbidden visiting graves but now allowed it, and lifted earlier restrictions on keeping sacrificial meat and on certain drinking vessels, while intoxicants stay forbidden.
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hatim al-Muzani: when someone whose religion and character you are pleased with proposes, marry him (your daughter or ward) to him, otherwise there will be turmoil and corruption in the land.
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Umar: whoever drinks intoxicants, his prayer is not accepted for forty days; if he repents Allah accepts his repentance.
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Amr: the merciful are shown mercy by Ar-Rahman; be merciful to those on earth and the One above the heavens will be merciful to you; whoever keeps the ties of kinship, Allah keeps ties with him.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: your smiling in the face of your brother is charity, commanding good and forbidding evil is charity, giving directions to a man lost in the land is charity, helping a man of poor sight is charity, and removing a rock, a thorn or a bone from the road is charity
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: remember often the destroyer of pleasures, meaning death.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Umar ibn al-Khattab: if you relied on Allah as He should be relied on, He would provide for you as He provides for the birds, which go out hungry in the morning and return full.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: the Prophet told Ubayy ibn Kab that nothing like Surat al-Fatihah has been revealed in the Torah, the Gospel, the Psalms or the Qur'an.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Anas: everything has a heart and the heart of the Qur'an is Ya Sin; whoever recites it, Allah writes for him the reward of reciting the Qur'an ten times. (Graded weak.)
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Ibn Abbas: a Companion heard someone reciting Surat al-Mulk from a grave; the Prophet said it is the defender and the deliverer from the punishment of the grave. (Graded weak.)
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: there is a surah of thirty verses that intercedes for a man until he is forgiven, Tabarak Alladhi bi-Yadihil-Mulk
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Masud: whoever recites a letter from Allah's Book gets a good deed, and each good deed is multiplied by ten; Alif is a letter, Lam is a letter and Mim is a letter.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: An-Numan ibn Bashir: the Prophet said supplication (dua) is worship, and recited "Call upon Me, I will respond to you" (Qur'an 40:60).
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: there is no servant who says every morning and every evening "In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in the heavens can cause harm, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing" three times, but nothing will harm him
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Umar: whoever sees a person afflicted and says "Praise be to Allah who saved me from what He tested you with and favoured me over many of His creation", will be spared that affliction. (Graded weak.)
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Talhah ibn Ubaydullah: on seeing the new moon the Prophet said "O Allah, bring it over us with blessing and faith, with safety and Islam; my Lord and your Lord is Allah". (Graded weak.)
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: whoever eats food and then says "All praise is due to Allah who fed me this and granted it to me without any strength or power from me", his earlier sins will be forgiven
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Anas: when something distressed him the Prophet would say "O Ever-Living, O Self-Sustaining, in Your mercy I seek relief".
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Aisha: the Prophet used to take care to fast on Mondays and Thursdays.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah: deeds are presented on Monday and Thursday, and the Prophet loved that his deeds be presented while he was fasting.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Zayd ibn Khalid al-Juhani: whoever provides a fasting person with food to break his fast gets the same reward as the fasting person, without reducing his reward.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Qays ibn Talq, from his father: asked about touching one's private part, the Prophet said it is only a piece of one's flesh.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Kabshah bint Kab: Abu Qatadah let a cat drink from the water she poured for his wudu, and said the Prophet said cats are not impure, they are among those who go about among you.
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah reported the Prophet said whoever treads a path seeking knowledge, Allah makes the way to Paradise easy for him
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Umar said the Prophet forbade fasting on the day you break your fast and the day you eat the meat of your sacrifices
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Mu'adh reported the Prophet said Allah's right on His servants is that they worship Him alone and associate nothing with Him, and the servants' right on Allah is that He does not punish the one who associates nothing with Him
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Sahl ibn Sa'd reported a woman offered herself in marriage, and a man who owned little was told to look for something even an iron ring, and was married to her for the Qur'an he knew
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Al-Bara reported the Prophet said on the day of Eid al-Adha that the first thing we do is pray and then return to slaughter, and whoever slaughtered before the prayer, it is only meat given to his family
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Said reported the Prophet said the Friday bath is compulsory for every adult male Muslim, with cleaning the teeth with siwak and using perfume if available
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah reported the Prophet said whoever bathes on Friday like the bath of janabah and goes early to the prayer, it is as if he offered a camel in sacrifice, and the reward lessens for each later hour
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: the best day on which the sun has risen is Friday; on it Adam was created and made to enter Paradise, and on it he was expelled from it, and the Last Hour will take place on a Friday
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha asked the Prophet what to say if she knew the Night of Al-Qadr, and he taught her to say O Allah, You are Pardoning, You love pardon, so pardon me
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Aisha reported that when the Prophet came out of the toilet he said: Ghufranaka, Your forgiveness
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Hudhayfah described the Prophet's night prayer: between the two prostrations he said, My Lord, forgive me, My Lord, forgive me
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Anas reported that whenever the Prophet went into the toilet he said: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the male and female evil spirits
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Anas reported that the Prophet used to perform ablution with one mudd of water
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Abbas reported that the Prophet said if somebody discards his religion, kill him
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abdullah reported the Prophet said the blood of a Muslim who confesses that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah cannot be shed except in three cases: a life for a life, a married person who commits illegal sexual intercourse, and the one who leaves Islam and separates from the community
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Jabir reported that a bedouin pledged himself to Islam, then asked the Prophet three times to cancel his pledge, was refused, and left Madinah
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha reported that the Prophet used to take the pledge from women by words only, and his hand did not touch any woman's hand except the one his right hand possessed
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Amr reported the Prophet said the best of you are those who are best to their womenfolk
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: some Companions told the Prophet they found in their minds thoughts too grave to speak of, and he said that this is the clear faith
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha reported that when believing women migrated to Madinah they were tested by the verse of allegiance, and whoever agreed to it, the Messenger said to her: I have accepted your pledge, by words only
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Amr reported that some people performed ablution hurriedly on a journey and their heels were dry, and the Prophet said woe to dry heels, because of Hell-fire, and told them to make their ablution thorough
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurairah reported the Prophet said a man is upon the religion of his friend, so let one of you look at whom he befriends
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Ali reported the Prophet said when you possess two hundred dirhams and one year passes on them, five dirhams are payable, and nothing is due on gold until it reaches twenty dinars, then half a dinar once a year has passed
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Ibn Abbas reported that the wife of Thabit ibn Qais separated from him for compensation and the Prophet made her waiting period one menstrual cycle
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: Thawban reported that the Prophet said if a woman asks her husband for khul' without any harm or cause, the scent of Paradise will be unlawful for her
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: Ali reported that Al-Abbas asked the Messenger of Allah about paying his zakat early, before it was due, and he gave him permission
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: the Prophet asked Bilal after the Fajr prayer what his best deed since Islam was, because he had heard the sound of his footsteps in front of him in Paradise, and Bilal said he always prayed after making wudu
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah reported the Prophet said that among the seven shaded by Allah on the day when there will be no shade but His is a man who gives charity so secretly that his left hand does not know what his right hand has given
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha reported that she never saw the Prophet fast a whole month except Ramadan and never saw him fast more in a month than in Sha'ban
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Umar reported that the Prophet passed by a man from the Ansar rebuking his brother about being shy, and said to leave him, because haya is a part of faith
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Bakra reported the Prophet said that the year has twelve months, of which four are sacred: Dhul-Qa'dah, Dhul-Hijjah and Muharram together, and Rajab
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Aisha said that Allah's Messenger died in her house on the day of her turn, leaning against her chest
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Anas reported that when Abd ar-Rahman ibn Awf married, the Prophet asked what dowry he gave and told him to hold a walimah even if it is with one sheep
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Anas reported the Prophet said that whoever wants his provision increased and his life lengthened should keep good relations with his relatives
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Amr reported the Prophet used to say that the best among you are the best in character
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah reported the Prophet said that he asked Allah's forgiveness and turned to Him in repentance more than seventy times every day
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Ibn Abbas reported the Prophet said that no good deed done on other days is better than those done in the first ten days of Dhul-Hijjah, not even jihad, except a man who goes out with his life and wealth and returns with nothing
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Zayd reported the Prophet went out to the prayer ground, invoked Allah for rain, faced the qibla, turned his cloak, and prayed two rak'ahs
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Al-Mughirah reported the Prophet used to pray until his feet or legs swelled, and when asked about it he said should I not be a thankful servant
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abdullah ibn Umar reported that the talbiyah of the Messenger of Allah was Labbayk Allahumma labbayk, labbayka la sharika laka labbayk, innal-hamda wan-ni'mata laka wal-mulk, la sharika lak
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah reported the Prophet advised him to fast three days each month, to pray two rak'ahs of Duha, and to pray witr before sleeping
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah reported the Prophet said that whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should not harm his neighbour, and that he advised them to treat women well
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Abu Hurayrah reported that Zaynab's name was Barrah, and it was said that by it she was claiming goodness for herself, so the Prophet changed her name to Zaynab
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: when he went to bed he would say "In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live", and when he got up he would say "Praise be to Allah who gave us life after He had made us die, and to Him is the resurrection"
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: the example of the one who remembers his Lord compared to the one who does not is that of a living creature compared to a dead one
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: do not make your houses into graveyards, for Satan runs away from the house in which Surah Al-Baqarah is recited
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: if anyone learns by heart the first ten verses of Surah al-Kahf, he will be protected from the Dajjal
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: He answered "Tie it and rely on Allah"
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: whoever says when leaving his house "In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, there is no might or power except by Allah" will be told that he is sufficed and protected
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: the supplication of Dhun-Nun when he supplicated in the belly of the whale was "There is none worthy of worship except You, glory be to You, I was among the wrongdoers"
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: he used to pass his right hand over the place of ailment and say "O Allah, Lord of the people, remove the trouble and heal the patient, for You are the Healer, no healing is of any avail but Yours, a healing that leaves behind no ailment"
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: commanded us to visit the sick, follow the funeral procession, answer the sneezer, fulfil the vow, help the poor, accept the invitation and greet everybody
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: when you visit the sick or the dead, say good things, because the angels say Amen to whatever you say
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: he sent word to her that whatever Allah takes is His, whatever He gives is His, and everything with Him has a fixed term, so she should be patient and hope for Allah's reward
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: nobody is given a blessing better and greater than patience
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: the superiority of Aisha to other women is like the superiority of tharid, an Arabic dish, to other meals
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: "This is Khadijah coming with a dish of food; when she reaches you, greet her on behalf of her Lord and on mine, and give her the good news of a palace in Paradise in which there will be no noise and no fatigue"
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: a good companion and an evil one are like a person carrying musk and a person blowing a pair of bellows: the musk carrier gives you perfume, or you buy some or at least smell a good scent, while the bellows blower burns your clothes or you get a bad smell
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Bilal was ordered to pronounce the adhan by saying its wordings twice and the iqamah by saying its wordings once
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: beware of suspicion, do not look for others' faults, do not spy, do not envy one another, and do not desert one another, but be servants of Allah and brothers
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: "I know a word which, if he said it, would make his anger go away: I seek refuge with Allah from Satan, the outcast"
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: there are two expressions, light on the tongue, heavy in the balance and dear to the Merciful: "Subhan Allah al-Azim" and "Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi"
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: when a man dies his deeds come to an end except three: recurring charity, knowledge from which people benefit, or a pious son who prays for him
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: he who died knowing that there is no god but Allah entered Paradise
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: the nearest a servant comes to his Lord is when he is prostrating himself, so make du'a in it
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: the two rak'ahs at dawn are better than this world and what it contains
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: there is an hour in the night in which no Muslim asks Allah for good in this world and the next without Allah giving it to him, and that applies to every night
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: he who has in his heart the weight of a mustard seed of pride will not enter Paradise
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: the best remembrance is "there is none worthy of worship except Allah" and the best supplication is "All praise is due to Allah"
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: "O Allah, suffice me with Your lawful against Your prohibited, and make me independent of all besides You by Your grace"
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: when the Prophet ﷺ put on a new garment he mentioned it by name, whether turban or shirt, and said "O Allah, praise be to You as You have clothed me with it, I ask You for its good and the good of that for which it was made, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil of that for which it was made"
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: a good dream is from Allah and a bad dream is from Satan, so if anyone sees something he dislikes in a dream, when he wakes he should blow three times on his left side and seek refuge with Allah from its evil, and it will not harm him
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: the names dearest to Allah are Abdullah and Abd al-Rahman
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: a Muslim is the one who avoids harming Muslims with his tongue and hands
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: none of you will have faith until he wishes for his brother what he likes for himself
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: commit yourself to the Qur'an, for by Him in whose Hand is my soul, it is more prone to escape than a camel in its tether
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: the lawful is clear and the unlawful is clear, and in between are doubtful matters that most people do not know, so whoever avoids the doubtful has protected his religion and his honour
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: "O Allah, set me apart from my sins as You set the east and west apart from each other; O Allah, clean me from sins as a white garment is cleaned of dirt; O Allah, wash my sins with water, snow and hail"
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: say "Subhan Allah", "Alhamdulillah" and "Allahu Akbar" thirty-three times each after every obligatory prayer
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the one who gives a bribe and the one who takes it
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: if both parties speak the truth and describe the defects and qualities of the goods, they will be blessed in their transaction, and if they tell lies or hide something, the blessing will be lost
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: I will be against three on the Day of Resurrection: one who makes a covenant in My name and betrays it, one who sells a free person and eats the price, and one who hires a labourer, gets the full work from him and does not pay him his wages
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: avoid the seven great destructive sins: joining others in worship with Allah, sorcery, killing a life Allah has forbidden without a just cause, taking riba, taking an orphan's wealth, fleeing from the battlefield, and accusing chaste women
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: I seek refuge with Allah's perfect words from every devil and from poisonous pests and from every evil, harmful eye
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: never used bad language, and used to say that the best among you are those with the best manners and character
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: during the lifetime of the Prophet ﷺ the moon was split into two parts, and the Prophet said "Bear witness to this"
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: joining partners with Allah and being undutiful to parents, and a forged statement and false witness
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: I and the one who looks after an orphan and provides for him will be in Paradise like this
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: one of the treasures of Paradise
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: "O Allah, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the torment of the Fire"
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: he who hoards is a sinner
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: O Allah, direct me to the right path and make me adhere to the straight path
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: he who prayed the morning prayer in congregation is under the protection of Allah
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: whoever sits in a sitting and engages in much empty, meaningless speech and then says before getting up "Glory is to You, O Allah, and praise, I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except You, I seek Your forgiveness and I repent to You", whatever occurred in that sitting will be forgiven to him
hadith.grader: Darussalam

hadith.english: in the Prophet's lifetime the sun eclipsed and he led the people in a prayer with long standing, a long bow, a second shorter standing and bow, and long prostrations, in each rak'ah; then he gave a sermon, and said the sun and moon are two signs of Allah that do not eclipse for anyone's death or life, so when you see it remember Allah, say takbir, pray and give charity
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: love of the Ansar is a sign of faith and hatred of the Ansar is a sign of hypocrisy
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: he asked which day, which town and which month it was, and when they said it was sacred he said that their blood, their property and their honour are sacred to one another like this day, in this town, in this month; he repeated it, asked whether he had conveyed the message, and told those present to pass it on to those absent
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: the Prophet ﷺ set out at the time of Hudaybiyyah, his camel sat down, and he said she was stopped by the One who stopped the elephant; he said that if the Quraysh asked for anything that honoured Allah's sanctities he would grant it
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: there is no migration after the conquest, but striving and good intentions, and when you are called to strive, respond
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: when the Prophet ﷺ entered Makkah on the day of the conquest there were 360 idols around the Ka'bah, and he struck them with a stick saying that truth has come and falsehood will neither start nor return
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: a son was born to him and he took him to the Prophet ﷺ, who named him Ibrahim, put a chewed date in his mouth (tahnik), prayed for blessing for him and returned him
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: the one who cuts the bond of kinship will not enter Paradise
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: whoever is pleased to have his provision widened and his life prolonged should keep good relations with his relatives
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: the Prophet ﷺ took hold of his shoulder and said to be in this world as if a stranger or a traveller
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: the days of Tashriq are days of eating and drinking
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: whoever brings up two girls properly until they reach maturity, he and I will come on the Day of Resurrection like this, and he joined his fingers
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: Paradise has a hundred grades, each as far from the next as heaven is from earth, and when you ask Allah ask for Al-Firdaws, which is the best and highest part of Paradise
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: for every step toward the mosque there is a reward, and your footprints are counted
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: no prophet was sent without warning his people about the one-eyed liar, who is blind in one eye while your Lord is not, and the word Kafir will be written between his eyes
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: the best rows for men are the first rows and the worst the last, and the best rows for women are the last and the worst for them the first
hadith.grader: Included in Sahih Muslim; the collection gives no separate grade

hadith.english: when the deceased is buried two angels, black and blue-eyed, come, one called Al-Munkar and the other An-Nakir, and ask what he used to say about this man; the believer says that he is Allah's slave and His Messenger, and his grave is made wide and lit for him and he is told to sleep like a newlywed
hadith.grader: al-Albani

hadith.english: the first cases to be judged between the people are those of bloodshed
hadith.grader: al-Albani
